title: Elucidation of DNA binding interaction of new Cu(II)/Zn(II) complexes derived from Schiff base and L-tryptophan amino acid: a multispectroscopic and molecular docking approach.
authors: Afzal, Mohd; Alarifi, Abdullah; Hasnain, Md Saquib; Muddassir, Mohd
journal: Environmental science and pollution research international
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型Cu(II)/Zn(II)配合物与DNA的沟槽结合，采用光谱实验和分子对接，虽为小分子-DNA互作而非TF-DNA体系，但对接方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA界面建模。
abstract: Herein, we describe the synthesis, structural elucidation, and DNA interaction of newly synthesized Cu(II) and Zn(II) complexes, i.e., [Cu(SB)(L-trp)(H(2)O)(2)]NO(3) (1) and [Zn(SB)(L-trp)(H(2)O)(2)]NO(3) (2) (SB = Schiff base obtained from the reaction between o-vanillin and 2-amino-2-methylpropane-1,3-diol; L-trp = L-tryptophan). From the analysis, a six-coordinated environment around the Cu(II) or Zn(II) center is proposed. The ability of the complexes to bind with calf thymus DNA was examined by optical spectroscopy (UV-vis titrations and steady-state fluorescence emission) and viscosity measurements. The vivid experimental results revealed that complexes 1 and 2 avidly bind to DNA through surface and groove binding modes, albeit with dissimilar intrinsic binding constants (1.54 x 10(4) and 1.36 x 10(4) M(-1) for 1 and 2, respectively). Both complexes can displace ethidium bromide (EB) to some extent from the intercalated EB-DNA system, resulting in fluorescence quenching. Additional experiments such as [Fe(CN)(6)](4-)-induced quenching and thermal melting confirmed the electrostatic and groove binding mode. Furthermore, molecular docking studies verified that both complexes locate in the DNA minor groove by surface binding and were stabilized through weak intermolecular forces. The binding affinity of the lowest energy docked pose was found to be -5.37 kcal/mol for complex 1 and - 5.18 kcal/mol for complex 2. The present work is expected to pave the way for the synthesis of DNA-targeting Cu(II)/Zn(II) metal complexes for the development of chemotherapeutic agents.
abstract_zh: 在此，我们描述了新合成的Cu(II)和Zn(II)配合物，即[Cu(SB)(L-trp)(H(2)O)(2)]NO(3) (1)和[Zn(SB)(L-trp)(H(2)O)(2)]NO(3) (2)（SB = 由邻香草醛与2-氨基-2-甲基丙烷-1,3-二醇反应得到的席夫碱；L-trp = L-色氨酸）的合成、结构解析及其与DNA的相互作用。通过分析，提出了Cu(II)或Zn(II)中心周围为六配位环境。通过光学光谱（紫外-可见滴定和稳态荧光发射）及粘度测量，考察了这些配合物与小牛胸腺DNA结合的能力。生动的实验结果表明，配合物1和2通过表面和沟槽结合模式紧密地结合DNA，尽管其内在结合常数不同（1和2分别为1.54 x 10(4)和1.36 x 10(4) M(-1)）。两种配合物均能在一定程度上从嵌入的EB-DNA体系中置换溴化乙锭（EB），导致荧光猝灭。额外的实验，如[Fe(CN)(6)](4-)诱导的猝灭和热熔解实验，证实了静电和沟槽结合模式。此外，分子对接研究验证了两种配合物通过表面结合定位于DNA小沟，并通过弱分子间作用力稳定。最低能量对接姿态的结合亲和力对于配合物1为-5.37 kcal/mol，对于配合物2为-5.18 kcal/mol。本工作预期为合成靶向DNA的Cu(II)/Zn(II)金属配合物以开发化疗药物铺平道路。
